BiblicalUsage: Abdiel is named once, in 1 Chronicles 5:15: 'Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.' He is a Gadite — the father of a clan chief east of the Jordan, in the genealogy of the tribe of Gad.
TheologicalSignificance: A single line in a genealogy is all we have of Abdiel, and it carries no teaching of its own. What it does show me is the Bible's care for families: a Gadite father and his chief son are remembered by name, and no tribe or household is lost in God's record of His people.
